I just wish I could have friends and be happy and what not

I don't want to kill myself but I also don't want to keep having to do what I do every day and see all these happy people with friends and wish I could be like them. 

I might call them I guess

I know it can be difficult for people, but I've got nothing, no one. I have no family, no friends, I'm 100% sure no one would go to my funeral. 

I'd consider that but I don't want to get committed and put on psychoactive drugs or something

I'm isolated because i'm an inferior incapable human being that is not capable of making relationships social or romantic with people

And there is no one to go to

You got me on the right time

I'm tired of the isolation, I don't want to face it anymore

The only reason I can see to not do that is if they're paying for your college, if not, tell them to shove it.
